$comment: Sample M&A information request list. Replace with the deal's actual IRL; ids are what classify_document maps documents onto.

items.title: Charter documents
items.description: Articles/certificate of incorporation, bylaws, and all amendments

items.title: Cap table and shareholder register
items.description: Current capitalization table, option pool, warrants, convertible instruments

items.title: Board and shareholder minutes
items.description: Minutes and written consents for the last 3 years

items.title: Audited financial statements
items.description: Audited annual financial statements for the last 3 fiscal years

items.title: Management accounts
items.description: Monthly or quarterly management accounts for the current fiscal year

items.title: Budget and forecasts
items.description: Current-year budget and any multi-year forecasts or business plans

items.title: Tax returns
items.description: Federal/national and state/local income tax returns for the last 3 years

items.title: Tax audits and disputes
items.description: Correspondence regarding audits, assessments, or ongoing tax disputes

items.title: Material customer contracts
items.description: Contracts with top-20 customers by revenue, including amendments and SOWs

items.title: Material supplier contracts
items.description: Contracts with critical suppliers and any sole-source arrangements

items.title: Key employment agreements
items.description: Employment agreements for executives and key employees, incl. change-of-control terms

items.title: Benefit and incentive plans
items.description: Equity incentive plans, bonus schemes, pension/retirement plans

items.title: Registered IP schedule
items.description: Patents, trademarks, registered designs and domains, with registration numbers

items.title: IP assignments and licenses
items.description: Inbound/outbound license agreements and employee/contractor IP assignments

items.title: Litigation summary
items.description: Pending, threatened, or settled litigation and regulatory proceedings, last 5 years

items.title: Licenses and permits
items.description: Material operating licenses, permits, and evidence of regulatory compliance

items.title: Data protection compliance
items.description: Privacy policies, processing registers, breach history, DPA templates

items.title: Insurance policies
items.description: Schedule of insurance policies with coverage limits and claims history
